quarterly_data.signal: Nidec's consolidated results (IFRS) for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, filed on TDnet on September 30, 2026 with prior-year figures restated for the inappropriate accounting identified by its third-party committee: net sales JPY 2,708,705 million (+3.9%); operating loss JPY 518,978 million (prior year, restated: operating profit JPY 128,222 million) after recording impairment losses on non-financial assets; loss attributable to owners of the parent JPY 564,624 million. quarterly_data.signal: Nidec (company statement in its FY3/2026 earnings release): in the precision small motor product group it is developing and expanding sales of products for data centers that support the AI society, including water-cooling modules and HDD motors for nearline use, evolving them as required to support the market's explosive growth, while also reviewing unprofitable models to raise profitability further.

Nidec precision small motor product group (HDD motors, brushless / fan motors, water-cooling modules and other small motors), FY ended March 2026: external sales JPY 498,696 million (+2.2%), of which HDD motors JPY 110,152 million (+9.8%) and other small motors JPY 388,544 million (+0.2%); operating profit JPY 29,995 million (-51.3%; margin 6.0% vs 12.6%). Q4 (January-March 2026): external sales JPY 131,768 million (+5.8% quarter on quarter), HDD motors JPY 29,608 million (+6.6% q/q), operating loss JPY 25,580 million.
quarterly_data.figure: FY3/2026 precision small motors sales JPY 498,696 million (+2.2%), HDD motors JPY 110,152 million (+9.8%), operating profit JPY 29,995 million (-51.3%); Q4 operating loss JPY 25,580 million

quarterly_data.signal: Nidec (company statement): in the appliance, commercial and industrial product group, demand for generators for data-center emergency power and for battery energy storage systems (BESS) continues to rise steadily; to meet this strong demand Nidec is pressing ahead with production-capacity expansion investment in India, France and North/Central America, and is strengthening downstream recurring business such as maintenance and inspection.

Nidec forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 (assuming US$1 = JPY 150 and EUR 1 = JPY 180): net sales JPY 2,800,000 million (+3.4%), operating profit JPY 200,000 million, profit before income taxes JPY 180,000 million, profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 100,000 million. First half (cumulative to September 2026): net sales JPY 1,400,000 million (+7.3%), operating profit JPY 120,000 million (+37.4%), profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 60,000 million (+104.1%). Dividends for the year are undecided.
quarterly_data.figure: FY3/2027 forecast: net sales JPY 2,800,000 million (+3.4%), operating profit JPY 200,000 million, net profit JPY 100,000 million; H1 net sales JPY 1,400,000 million (+7.3%), operating profit JPY 120,000 million (+37.4%)

quarterly_data.signal: Nidec's "Re-Definition" Nidec management reform five-year plan (FY2026-FY2030; basic policy announced May 13, 2026, replacing Conversion2027; a mid-term plan with business strategies and numerical plans is being drawn up): the company names AI data centers, energy and semiconductor-related fields as growth areas where high profitability and market growth are expected, will invest actively there and expand into new business models such as solutions, and will promptly exit or sell low-growth or low-profit businesses. Businesses are being reorganized around five pillars (Better Life, Electrification & Energy Infrastructure, Digital Society Solutions, Manufacturing Solutions, Mobility Innovation), and the plan targets consolidating 248 sites (as of March 2026) into 160-180 sites and 353 legal entities into 160-180.
